research.primalmagickextended.familiar_c: I have learned to summon or reshape creatures, and built a portal to another realm. I've formed bonds with animals, but I believe I can make a deeper bond, a magickal bond. It would take a ritual to craft it into a physical form.

I have figured out the ritual. A few runes of power, and a few items attractive to beasts, to lure their spirits close and link them to mine. The ritual will produce a collar, which I can give to any animal that's already tamed and loyal to me. Bound to my spirit, it would be protected - anything that harmed it would instead have it slip away into another realm, where I should be able to summon it back to me.
In addition, such a beast present nearby could bear some of the cost of spellcasting for me, contributing its mana to mine and making spellcasting easier.
I can keep only one familiar; binding another would release the first back to ordinary life, though still loyal and unharmed. To call or dismiss a familiar at will, however, I will need a spell.
research.primalmagickextended.find_famil: With a familiar bound, its presence lingers at the edge of my thoughts even when it is far away. Surely that thread can be pulled upon with a spell.

Find Familiar is a spell that calls my bound familiar to my side if it is absent, or dismisses it if it is present. The spell's target is unimportant, as it travels along the familiar bond and not through space.
A familiar that was dismissed, lost, or seemingly destroyed returns whole, still bearing its name and collar.
Now that I have access to the energies of the Void, it should be possible for a portal to bore across dimensions.

By combining materials from the Nether and the End, I can now create a rune that will cross the void and connect dimensions. It may need to be combined with an appropriate Enhancer Rune, depending on where in the dimensions the portals are found.
research.primalmagickextended.haste_rune: Using the power of the Void, I should be able to quicken my portals, linking locations instantly.
With this rune, a portal will work instantaneously, like the Endermen's teleportation rather than the slow transit of a Nether Portal.
research.primalmagickextended.infinity_r: Now that I have access to the energies of the Void, there should be no limit to the distance a portal can cross.

The materials are quite costly - only a rune forged of netherite can cross such distances. But using one, a portal should be able to link across any distance, traversing the entire world, though still limited to travel within the same dimension.
research.primalmagickextended.portal_tra: Obsidian and flame can naturally create a portal to the Nether, but what if I applied magick to a portal? Might I be able to connect other places?

With a bit of infernal magick and the natural teleportation abilities of Ender Pearls and Eyes of Ender, I can create portals anywhere I desire! I use the Ender Pearls and Eyes of Ender to create a portal catalyst, adding a bit of dye to give it a color, and then toss it into a frame made of any single material. If another frame made of the same material with the same color catalyst is nearby, they link up directly, creating a portal between them.
Unfortunately, the range is fairly limited, and it cannot cross dimensions. Perhaps more research is required...
research.primalmagickextended.strong_enh: With my greater knowledge of runecrafting, I could invent a better portal enhancer rune.

Using prismarine inks, I have devised a superior rune that will extend the range of a portal another tenfold.  With this rune, I can reach ten kilometers away, traversing great distances in a single jump.  Once again, it shouldn't matter which end of the portal I apply the rune to, either should work.
research.primalmagickextended.weak_enhan: While the portals are very useful, their range is inconveniently short. With my knowledge of runecrafting, could I draw a rune on the portal frame to extend its range?

I have devised a rune that will extend the range of a portal, allowing me to connect ten times further than before, up to 1000 meters. The rune is a bit too large to scribe on a stone tablet at the runescribing table, but I should be able to put one together at my Arcane Workbench. If I apply the rune to the frame of a portal, it should allow it to link up to a greater distance. It shouldn't matter which end of the portal I apply the rune to, either should work.
